reading.body:
Steven Horsford's AI record is four sponsored or cosponsored AI bills, four recorded votes, and ten political committee contributions from Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, and Oracle between March 2025 and June 2026.

The contributions are the densest part of the record. Ten of the eighteen events are money, and they arrive from the largest AI and cloud companies on a fairly steady cadence rather than in one cluster. Microsoft appears three times, Amazon three times, Google twice, Meta twice, Oracle once. Individual amounts run from $1,000 to $5,000, with Oracle's $5,000 the largest single entry.

The legislative side is thinner and mostly early-stage. Horsford cosponsored the AI Impersonation Prevention Act in July 2025 and the AI Tax Integrity Act in June 2026, and sponsored the AI-Related Job Impacts Clarity Act in June 2026. The votes recorded are procedural, motions to suspend the rules, and one of the four is an absence rather than a position. Nothing here shows a bill becoming law.

What the data does not contain is any causal link between the money and the legislation, and the record itself says placement in date order is not a claim that one event caused another. It also does not cover committee assignments, floor speeches, or any AI activity outside bills, votes, and FEC filings. The reader gets a timeline of what was filed and voted, not an account of influence.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Steven Horsford: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 18 events.
